title: Five Girls Storm a Mansion at Midnight — Part 1

series.summary: Rentarou gathers all four of Hakari's fellow girlfriends at midnight and leads them over the walls of the Hanazono mansion to take Hakari back.

segments.voiceover_text: One boy. Five girls charging into the night behind him. And a mother watching from her mansion window, certain she has already won. Hakari's love is about to be tested like never before.

Rentarou's eyes burn white with desperation. By midnight he has gathered Karane, Shizuka, Nano and Kusuri at the playground. Every girlfriend answered the call. They race to the Hanazono mansion, its iron fence towering over them. Nobody hesitates.
Rentarou drops inside first, then lifts each girl over the spikes. Five hands stack into one circle on the cold tiles. But the mansion is already watching — what waits for them in the dark?
